summary: HelloTeams is a Melbourne-founded Microsoft Teams Phone provider (Operator Connect, Direct Routing) operating in several regions and expanding into Germany via partners. Finance Manager Stefan Pahos, CPA, runs bookkeeping for four entities (AU, US, UK, NZ) and prepares monthly consolidated board reports.

claims.text: HelloTeams is a Microsoft Teams Phone provider founded in 2021 and headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
claims.quote: HelloTeams is a Microsoft Teams Phone provider. We empower businesses around the world to connect and deploy Teams Calling in 15 minutes

claims.text: Stefan Pahos is Finance Manager at HelloTeams (current), in the role since March 2026 after nine months as Bookkeeper.
Stefan does full-function bookkeeping for four HelloTeams entities (AU, US, UK, NZ), including AP, AR, bank reconciliations and payroll oversight.
claims.quote: Full-function bookkeeping for four Helloteams entities (AU, US, UK, NZ), including oversight of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Bank reconciliations, Payroll

claims.text: Stefan prepares monthly consolidated board reports with budget variance analysis, and processes month-end and year-end reconciliations.
claims.quote: Prepare monthly consolidated board reports, including budget variance analysis and month-on-month and year-on-year comparisons

claims.text: Stefan posted on LinkedIn about the bare minimum you should expect from your bookkeeper, accountant or finance team.
claims.quote: The bare minimum you should expect from your bookkeeper / accountant / finance team.

claims.text: Stefan is also a CPA, registered BAS agent and Xero Advisor certified, and runs Pahos and Co on the side.
claims.quote: Registered BAS Agent by Tax Practitioners Board

claims.text: HelloTeams announced a technology partnership with Solgari in August 2026 to expand into Germany.
claims.quote: HelloTeams has announced its technological partnership with Solgari

claims.text: HelloTeams announced a new partnership with CCP Software GmbH in October 2026 to serve organisations across DACH.
claims.quote: We're pleased to announce a new partnership between HelloTeams and CCP Software GmbH!

claims.text: HelloTeams went global in 2022 with branches in the UK, the US and New Zealand and became a Microsoft-certified Operator Connect provider in 2023.
claims.quote: HelloTeams goes global, serving more than 19 regions through dedicated branches in the UK, the US, and New Zealand.

hooks.text: Stefan personally runs bookkeeping and reconciliations across four entities and a consolidated board report, a clear multi-entity close burden.
His own post on the bare minimum to expect from a finance team shows he cares about standards and trust in the numbers.
DACH expansion through Solgari and CCP adds a new region to the close.

risks.text: Very small team (about 10 staff, 2 in finance) so budget may be limited; Stefan also runs a side practice and is an Xero-certified advisor, so he may favour his existing tooling.

gaps: Accounting stack (Xero) not confirmed on a HelloTeams primary page; Stefan is Xero Advisor certified.
